notes.title: The Zebra-Man! is now better than ever!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33243736/5ecb2a051197bfafe4f693a6f6230aba5cb5fc02.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone! 

Hope you are having a fantastic week! Because it's about to get better. We've brought you an update for The Zebra-Man game! It is version 2.5.3. 

In this new version we fixed minor issues, such as the lighting of the 3D levels, removed the constant pop-up every time you eliminated an enemy and solved the problem of undefined NPC pushing. 

Below you have the Patch Note of [b]version 2.5.3[/b]: 

[list]
[*] Constant Stat Update (NPCs killed) now only shows when Achievement is Unlocked
[*] Added linear damp to npcs so they are not pushed indefinitely
[*] Remade the lighting batch of 3D levels
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055360/The_ZebraMan/
